sourcePackage.title: Texas Instruments AM62p Starter Kit Evaluation Module (SK EVM)
sourcePackage.description: This board support package (BSP) is for the TI AM62p SK EVM. This BSP contains prebuilt binaries and buildfiles to boot your board with the QNX OS 8.0. In addition, this BSP provides source code for various drivers that you can build. For documentation to use this BSP, download the user's guide.
